name: hashteams
title: hashteams
blurb: computes which of 65536 teams an atproto account belongs to: UTF-8 encode the DID, SHA-256 it, take the first two bytes as a big-endian integer, then add one so teams run 1-65536. signing in lets you opt into a public roster so others can see who shares your team; nobody appears in it without asking. the homepage also ranks the most populated teams among opted-in accounts. methodology and worked example (#29812) from @mfzx.net.
